units.locator: Article 5.31. Breach or non-performance of obligations under a collective contract or agreement

units.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors
units.text: 1. Non-performance or improper performance by parents or other legal representatives of minors of duties concerning the maintenance, upbringing and education of minors and the protection of their rights and interests —
units.label: Part 1 Art. 5.35

units.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors
units.text: shall entail a warning or an administrative fine of five hundred to two thousand roubles.

units.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors
units.text: 2. Violation by parents or other legal representatives of minors of the rights and interests of minors, consisting of depriving them of the right to communicate with their parents or close relatives where such communication does not conflict with the children's interests; deliberately concealing the children's whereabouts against their will; failing to comply with a court decision determining the children's place of residence, including a court decision determining their place of residence for the period before a court decision determining their place of residence takes legal effect; failing to comply with a court decision on the manner of exercising parental rights or on the manner of exercising parental rights for the period before the court decision takes legal effect; or otherwise obstructing parents' exercise of their rights to raise and educate their children and to protect their children's rights and interests —
units.label: Part 2 Art. 5.35

units.locator: Article 5.35. Failure by parents or other legal representatives of minors to fulfil duties concerning the maintenance and upbringing of minors

units.text: shall entail compulsory work for up to one hundred and fifty hours or administrative arrest for ten to fifteen days, or an administrative fine of twenty thousand roubles for persons to whom compulsory work or administrative arrest cannot be applied under this Code.
